course_name_en: Fundamental Rights and Responsibilities in Higher Education

learning_outcomes.text: They will be able to explain the solutions to problems they may encounter in higher education processes within the framework of higher education law.
They will be able to interpret higher education law problems and solutions by using the knowledge they have acquired on current higher education law regulations.
Thanks to the knowledge they have acquired regarding higher education law, they will be able to identify relevant problems within the framework of professional and ethical principles.
They will be able to explain the consequences of behavior contrary to higher education law.
They will be able to analyze the rules determined by the laws related to higher education legislation and the judicial decisions related to these rules.

syllabus_topics: Higher education institutions and their fundamental bodies
Academic units and titles; appointment and common academic and administrative provisions
Evaluation of higher education processes with judicial decisions
Higher education student processes (Undergraduate: student processes)
Higher education student processes (Undergraduate: regulations, directives)
Higher education student processes (KOOP, internship, Presidential Internship Mobilization)
Evaluation of higher education disciplinary affairs with judicial decisions
Listening to student presentations and evaluating higher education disciplinary affairs with judicial decisions
